task: Bug fix: selectedSportId not preserved when navigating from prematch favorites to live special
userCommand: Keep selectedSportId='*' when coming from favorites and opening a live special
rootCause: LiveMobileMatches and LiveMobileLeagueGroupedMatches (packages/betting) call setSport(firstAvailableSport) when no matches found for current sport. When selectedSportId='*' (favorites), they find no matches and reset the sport. These components cannot be modified (packages constraint).
fix: In web-shell live special page: read selectedSportId from useFilter() and conditionally skip rendering LiveMobileOffer when selectedSportId==='*'. This prevents the setSport auto-reset.
note: UX tradeoff: when on favorites page viewing a live special, the mobile sidebar (LiveMobileOffer) is not rendered. This is a web-shell-only constraint necessity, as the fix cannot be placed in packages/betting.
